artist_notes.name: Shaun Ross
artist_notes.note: Model, artist and DJ, a fixture on LA's fashion-adjacent party circuit.

curator_note: Hard to call from the bill alone: Shaun Ross is more scene-and-style than selector, and the other two names are unverified. Only worth it if you're already out and want a no-phones room.
description: "No Photos Plz" electronic night at Say Yes on Sat 11/28 from 9pm, with Shaun Ross, BODII and nish.

curator_note: John Summit playing the Coliseum is the tech-house boom at full stadium scale, and a real milestone for a guy who was packing small rooms a few years back. Big-room fun, so go for the singalong drops and the production, not for deep selection.
description: John Summit's Ctrl Escape tour stops at the 77,000-capacity LA Memorial Coliseum on Fri 12/11.

curator_note: A Chinatown disco-and-house night with a 7pm start, so it's an early evening warm-up rather than a late-night commitment. I can't verify the artists, so treat it as a low-stakes drop-in for the groove.
description: "Disco Decadance" electronic night at Apotheke in Chinatown from 7pm Sat 12/5, featuring Infinity Edge, NAYGOD and Dirtie Blonde.

curator_note: Cole Escola's Tony-winning Broadway farce, in which Mary Todd Lincoln is a washed-up would-be cabaret star, is fast and absurd, and the touring run has been selling well. Funny and camp as hell, though it's very much a queer comedy-theater night, not a music one.
description: Touring production of Cole Escola's Broadway comedy Oh, Mary!, a camp farce about Mary Todd Lincoln, at the Ahmanson Theatre.
